name: Frequency hallway
summary: A corridor of glowing frequency bars on the floor, ceiling and walls, rushing past as you travel down it.
credit: After vizz.fm's Frequency Hallway (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Every Spacing a new row of bars is born at the far end from the spectrum then: on each surface the lows in the middle, the highs toward the corners. Rows ride toward you, faster with the energy and on each beat. The view sways a little with the bar.

params.label: Width
params.help: The corridor's width against its height.

params.label: Bar reach
params.help: How far a full bar reaches toward the middle of the corridor.

params.label: Sway
params.help: How far the view sways once a bar, as much as the beat is sure.

params.label: Bars
params.help: Boxes: each bar a glass box in 3D, edges bright. Flat: each bar a soft glowing strip facing you.

params.label: Box depth
params.help: With Boxes: how deep a box is, as a share of the gap between rows.
